QUOTE: Both switch tables are generated. `library/error.c` is the output of `scripts/generate_errors.pl`, run by a CMake custom command in `library/CMakeLists.txt:134`. That command takes `include/mbedtls` and `scripts/data_files`, and depends on the error headers and `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states error.c is generated by scripts/generate_errors.pl from the public headers, with error.fmt as a dependency. It does not call error.fmt a "template" in so many words, but it names the file as an input to the generator.
